cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: More Power, More Problems
cards.instruction: Celebrate every burden, restriction, or crisis as evidence that your influence is expanding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Another complaint about me! I'm the focus of the hotel. You remember when I taught you to attract a guest's attention?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm taking you off reception while I investigate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Decisive—just as I trained you. Wonderful: now management is organizing its day around me too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll answer every complaint in writing from the laundry office.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My influence has reached laundry! You're finally giving me a department of my own. Bring a whole ream of paper; I taught you to anticipate demand.

reason: Make the specific pupil assessment, correction or influence claim shape the pursuit and the response to each partner contribution.
